issues.source_quote: Кто возьмёт билетов пачку, тот получит... Водокачку!
issues.translation_quote: Buy a whole stack of tickets and you could win... a pumping station!
issues.justification: The rhyme (пачку/водокачку) of the slogan is lost, so the comic couplet does not land.

issues.source_quote: Это - я, я, я! ... Цигель, цигель, ай-люлю
issues.justification: The foreign-language gibberish is transliterated inconsistently, with some pieces altered, and the Russian 'Бор! ... [Простите, погорячился...]' gags depend on the viewer hearing nonsense rendered the same way.

issues.source_quote: Поехали к шефу В таком виде... я не могу.
issues.translation_quote: Let's go to the boss. Not looking like this... I can't.
issues.justification: The drunken Gesha/Lyolik exchange lacks the humor of Lyolik's mocking repetition of 'ванна/кофэ/какава с чаем'; 'tea-yo' is an odd invention.
The 'Облико морале' line is a Soviet-era phrase ('moral character') and the English adds 'impeccable', which changes the tone.
